test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

My teacher forbids to trust one’s relatives.

options.text: My teacher says, “Never trust your relatives.”
My teacher says, “Never trust my relatives.”
My teacher says, “Never trusted your relatives.”
My teacher said “Never trust your relatives.”

solution:
The correct answer is** My teacher says, “Never trust your relatives.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it to Direct Speech. 
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb is in the present tense.
 
• So, the tense of the reported speech will remain the same.
 
• We change the tense and pronouns of reported speech only when reporting verb is in the past tense.
 
• In the given sentence 'one's' will be changed into 'your' because the second-person pronouns are changed according to the **object** of the reporting verb.
 
• In the original sentence,** "one's" **is **a third-person pronoun **that refers to people in general, without specifying any individual in particular. When the sentence is changed into **direct speech,** it is more natural to make the statement more personal by using the** second-person pronoun** **"your" **instead of** "one's."**
 
• While changing the given Indirect narration into Direct narration, commas, and inverted commas will be added, and connector 'to' will be removed.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *My teacher says, “Never trust your relatives.” *
